titulo_original: Da je kuća dobra i vuk bi je imao

sinopsis.es: Durante el cumpleaños de su marido, Sandra pasa el día con la familia de él. A medida que la hostilidad aumenta, le cuesta distinguir lo que sucede de lo que imagina.
sinopsis.en: At her husband’s birthday celebration, Sandra spends the day with his family. As their hostility grows, she finds it harder to separate what happens from what she imagines.
